[USER] User requested a recipe for a healthy chicken salad that can be made in bulk.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided a healthy chicken salad recipe that makes about 6 servings.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Listed ingredients and instructions for the chicken salad:  
- Ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast, 1/2 cup plain Greek yogurt, 1/4 cup chopped celery, 1/4 cup chopped red bell pepper, 1/4 cup chopped cucumber, 1/4 cup chopped walnuts, 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard, 1 tablespoon honey, salt and pepper to taste, fresh parsley or dill (optional).  
- Instructions: Combine ingredients, whisk mustard and honey, mix, season, refrigerate, garnish.
